# Columns of `m.snapshots`

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

Each section lists one dataset's columns in the order every verb returns them. **Supplied by** names the transports that fill a column; a column the serving transport does not fill is null. The wire-field columns name the Massive fields behind each column (`request` for a value the library fills from the request). The same descriptions appear in the web UI's column tooltips and in a query's `columns()`.

In a session with `unknown_symbols=dm.UnknownSymbols.WARN` (or `MASSIVE_UNKNOWN_SYMBOLS=warn`), `m.snapshots` also has a `RawSymbol` String column, which holds Massive's spelling of a symbol the library cannot read; that row's `Symbol` is null, and `RawSymbol` is null on every other row. The tables below show the default session, without it.

<a id="snapshots"></a>

## `m.snapshots`

The current state of tickers of any asset classes, from Massive's unified snapshot.

| Column | Deephaven type | Description | Supplied by | REST field |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The instrument, in the library's canonical symbol form. From REST `ticker`: "The ticker symbol for the asset." | REST | `ticker` |
| `OptionRoot` | String | The OCC option root, read from `Symbol`: the symbol without its `O:` prefix and its last 15 characters (expiry, type, and strike), such as `SPXW` for `O:SPXW251219C06000000`. It is never mapped to the underlying: an adjusted contract keeps its own root, such as `AAPL1`. Null on a row of any other class. | REST | `ticker` |
| `BreakEvenPrice` | double | The price of the underlying asset for the contract to break even. For a call, this value is (strike price + premium paid). For a put, this value is (strike price - premium paid). | REST | `break_even_price` |
| `DetailsContractType` | String | The type of contract. Can be "put", "call", or in some rare cases, "other". From the `details` object: The details for this contract. | REST | `details.contract_type` |
| `DetailsExerciseStyle` | String | The exercise style of this contract. See this link (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Option_style) for more details on exercise styles. From the `details` object: The details for this contract. | REST | `details.exercise_style` |
| `DetailsExpirationDate` | String | The contract's expiration date in YYYY-MM-DD format. From the `details` object: The details for this contract. | REST | `details.expiration_date` |
| `DetailsSharesPerContract` | double | The number of shares per contract for this contract. From the `details` object: The details for this contract. | REST | `details.shares_per_contract` |
| `DetailsStrikePrice` | double | The strike price of the option contract. From the `details` object: The details for this contract. | REST | `details.strike_price` |
| `Error` | String | The error while looking for this ticker. | REST | `error` |
| `Fmv` | double | Fair Market Value is only available on Business plans. It is our proprietary algorithm to generate a real-time, accurate, fair market value of a tradable security. For more information, contact us (https://massive.com/contact). | REST | `fmv` |
| `FmvLastUpdated` | Instant | If Fair Market Value (FMV) is available, this field is the nanosecond timestamp of the last FMV calculation. | REST | `fmv_last_updated` |
| `GreeksDelta` | double | The change in the option's price per $0.01 increment in the price of the underlying asset. From the `greeks` object: The greeks for this contract. There are certain circumstances where greeks will not be returned, such as options contracts that are deep in the money. See this article (https://massive.com/blog/greeks-and-implied-volatility/#testing) for more information. | REST | `greeks.delta` |
| `GreeksGamma` | double | The change in delta per $0.01 change in the price of the underlying asset. From the `greeks` object: The greeks for this contract. There are certain circumstances where greeks will not be returned, such as options contracts that are deep in the money. See this article (https://massive.com/blog/greeks-and-implied-volatility/#testing) for more information. | REST | `greeks.gamma` |
| `GreeksTheta` | double | The change in the option's price per day. From the `greeks` object: The greeks for this contract. There are certain circumstances where greeks will not be returned, such as options contracts that are deep in the money. See this article (https://massive.com/blog/greeks-and-implied-volatility/#testing) for more information. | REST | `greeks.theta` |
| `GreeksVega` | double | The change in the option's price per 1% increment in volatility. From the `greeks` object: The greeks for this contract. There are certain circumstances where greeks will not be returned, such as options contracts that are deep in the money. See this article (https://massive.com/blog/greeks-and-implied-volatility/#testing) for more information. | REST | `greeks.vega` |
| `ImpliedVolatility` | double | The market's forecast for the volatility of the underlying asset, based on this option's current price. | REST | `implied_volatility` |
| `LastMinuteClose` | double | The closing value for the minute aggreate. From the `last_minute` object: The most recent minute aggregate for this stock. | REST | `last_minute.close` |
| `LastMinuteDecimalVolume` | String | The trading volume for the minute aggregate with decimal precision. This field provides support for fractional shares, representing volume as a decimal string where the fractional part is expressed in millionths. This field is only returned for stocks snapshots. From the `last_minute` object: The most recent minute aggregate for this stock. | REST | `last_minute.decimal_volume` |
| `LastMinuteHigh` | double | The highest value for the minute aggregate. From the `last_minute` object: The most recent minute aggregate for this stock. | REST | `last_minute.high` |
| `LastMinuteLow` | double | The lowest value for the minute aggregate. From the `last_minute` object: The most recent minute aggregate for this stock. | REST | `last_minute.low` |
| `LastMinuteOpen` | double | The open value for the minute aggregate. From the `last_minute` object: The most recent minute aggregate for this stock. | REST | `last_minute.open` |
| `LastMinuteTransactions` | long | The number of transactions that took place within the minute aggregate. From the `last_minute` object: The most recent minute aggregate for this stock. | REST | `last_minute.transactions` |
| `LastMinuteVolume` | double | The trading volume for the minute aggregate. From the `last_minute` object: The most recent minute aggregate for this stock. | REST | `last_minute.volume` |
| `LastMinuteVwap` | double | The trading volume weighted average price for the minute aggregate. From the `last_minute` object: The most recent minute aggregate for this stock. | REST | `last_minute.vwap` |
| `LastQuoteAsk` | double | The ask price. From the `last_quote` object: The most recent quote for this contract. This is only returned if your current plan includes quotes. | REST | `last_quote.ask` |

From the `last_quote` object: The most recent quote for this contract. This is only returned if your current plan includes quotes. | REST | `last_quote.ask_exchange` |
| `LastQuoteAskSize` | double | The ask size. This represents the number of shares, or contracts for options, sellers are offering at the given ask price. From the `last_quote` object: The most recent quote for this contract. This is only returned if your current plan includes quotes. | REST | `last_quote.ask_size` |
| `LastQuoteBid` | double | The bid price. From the `last_quote` object: The most recent quote for this contract. This is only returned if your current plan includes quotes. | REST | `last_quote.bid` |
| `LastQuoteBidExchange` | long | The bid side exchange ID. See Exchanges (https://massive.com/docs/rest/options/market-operations/exchanges) for Massive's mapping of exchange IDs. From the `last_quote` object: The most recent quote for this contract. This is only returned if your current plan includes quotes. | REST | `last_quote.bid_exchange` |
| `LastQuoteBidSize` | double | The bid size. This represents the number of shares, or contracts for options, buyers are bidding for at the given bid price. From the `last_quote` object: The most recent quote for this contract. This is only returned if your current plan includes quotes. | REST | `last_quote.bid_size` |
| `LastQuoteLastUpdated` | Instant | The nanosecond timestamp of when this information was updated. From the `last_quote` object: The most recent quote for this contract. This is only returned if your current plan includes quotes. | REST | `last_quote.last_updated` |
| `LastQuoteMidpoint` | double | The average of the bid and ask price. From the `last_quote` object: The most recent quote for this contract. This is only returned if your current plan includes quotes. | REST | `last_quote.midpoint` |
| `LastQuoteTimeframe` | String | The time relevance of the data. From the `last_quote` object: The most recent quote for this contract. This is only returned if your current plan includes quotes. | REST | `last_quote.timeframe` |
| `LastTradeConditions` | long[] | A list of condition codes. The codes depend on the asset type; see the condition codes for stocks (https://massive.com/docs/rest/stocks/market-operations/condition-codes), options (https://massive.com/docs/rest/options/market-operations/condition-codes), or crypto (https://massive.com/docs/rest/crypto/market-operations/condition-codes). From the `last_trade` object: The most recent trade for this contract. This is only returned if your current plan includes trades. | REST | `last_trade.conditions` |
| `LastTradeDecimalSize` | String | The size of a trade, including fractional shares, represented as a decimal string where the fractional part is expressed in millionths. This field is only returned for stocks snapshots. From the `last_trade` object: The most recent trade for this contract. This is only returned if your current plan includes trades. | REST | `last_trade.decimal_size` |
| `LastTradeExchange` | long | The exchange ID. See Exchanges (https://massive.com/docs/rest/stocks/market-operations/exchanges) for Massive's mapping of exchange IDs. From the `last_trade` object: The most recent trade for this contract. This is only returned if your current plan includes trades. | REST | `last_trade.exchange` |
| `LastTradeId` | String | The Trade ID which uniquely identifies a trade. These are unique per combination of ticker, exchange, and TRF. For example: A trade for AAPL executed on NYSE and a trade for AAPL executed on NASDAQ could potentially have the same Trade ID. From the `last_trade` object: The most recent trade for this contract. This is only returned if your current plan includes trades. | REST | `last_trade.id` |
| `LastTradeLastUpdated` | Instant | The nanosecond timestamp of when this information was updated. From the `last_trade` object: The most recent trade for this contract. This is only returned if your current plan includes trades. | REST | `last_trade.last_updated` |
| `LastTradeParticipantTimestamp` | Instant | The nanosecond Exchange Unix Timestamp. This is the timestamp of when the trade was generated at the exchange. | `LastTradePrice` | double | The price of the trade. This is the actual dollar value per whole share of this trade. This is only returned if your current plan includes trades. | REST | `last_trade.price` |
| `LastTradeSipTimestamp` | Instant | The nanosecond accuracy SIP Unix Timestamp. This is the timestamp of when the SIP received this trade from the exchange which produced it. From the `last_trade` object: The most recent trade for this contract. This is only returned if your current plan includes trades. | REST | `last_trade.sip_timestamp` |
| `LastTradeSize` | long | The size of a trade (also known as volume). From the `last_trade` object: The most recent trade for this contract. This is only returned if your current plan includes trades. | REST | `last_trade.size` |
| `LastTradeTimeframe` | String | The time relevance of the data. From the `last_trade` object: The most recent trade for this contract. This is only returned if your current plan includes trades. | REST | `last_trade.timeframe` |
| `LastUpdated` | Instant | The nanosecond timestamp of when this information was updated. | REST | `last_updated` |

Possible values for stocks, options, crypto, and forex snapshots are open, closed, early_trading, or late_trading. Possible values for indices snapshots are regular_trading, closed, early_trading, and late_trading. | REST | `market_status` |
| `Message` | String | The error message while looking for this ticker. | REST | `message` |

| `SessionChange` | double | The value of the price change for the asset from the previous trading day. From the `session` object: Comprehensive trading session metrics, detailing price changes, trading volume, and key price points (open, close, high, low) for the asset within the current trading day. Includes specific changes during early, regular, and late trading periods to enable detailed performance analysis and trend tracking. Values describe the current trading session only; nothing carries over from the previous session apart from `previous_close`. For stocks snapshots, an asset that has not traded yet this session reports `volume: 0` with the price and change fields omitted rather than reported as 0. During early trading on stocks snapshots, `volume` and `price` track the session as it happens, but `open`, `high`, `low`, `close` and `vwap` are omitted until the regular session opens, as those report official session prices. They appear from the open and remain through late trading. | REST | `session.change` |
